summary: Verified Feature 1 (server-side share previews via GET /api/og) and Feature 2 (regenerated Omnivest logo) end-to-end. Wrote 18 pytest tests covering per-route og:title / twitter:title / og:image / fallbacks / canonical / JS redirect / static assets — all 18 passed. Ran Playwright regression: navbar logo renders, Share button is present & clickable on model-portfolio detail route, page titles differ per route (/, /about, /faq), no JS console errors. Build-time prerender script explicitly not tested per request.
critical_code_review_comments: og.py _extract meta regex is fine but note that server-issued HTML sets Cache-Control public max-age=300 — if a bug ever ships in copy, previews will be cached by crawlers for 5 min; acceptable.
ShareButton uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL directly — correct pattern; no hardcoded URLs.
og.py handles unknown/unapproved portfolio IDs gracefully by falling back to the /model-portfolios listing preview (verified). Good defensive coding.
PAGE_META in backend og.py must stay in sync with frontend Layout.jsx PAGE_META — consider a single source of truth (e.g. a JSON file loaded by both) to prevent future drift.
seed_data_creation: None. Preview DB has 0 approved portfolios — dynamic /api/og portfolio branch was verified via its documented fallback path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_og_share.py at /app/backend/tests/ can be re-run to verify Feature 1 remains healthy. Note: the build-time prerender script (scripts/prerender-og.js) only runs on production `yarn build` and cannot be tested in the preview dev server. Real social-crawler previews (WhatsApp/FB/LinkedIn) can only be verified after deploy by pasting a full https URL like https://<host>/api/og?path=/about into the debugger tool of each platform.
rca of the issue: Previous implementation relied only on react-helmet-async (client-side JS). Social crawlers don't execute JS, so they always saw the SSR'd index.html tags → identical homepage preview for every shared URL. Fix: introduced FastAPI endpoint /api/og that returns raw HTML with correct per-route OG/Twitter tags plus a JS redirect for human browsers. Confirmed 9 static routes now emit 9 distinct titles and correct og:image (1200x630). Verified.
